python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, json, hashlib, pathlib
R="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx"
P=R+"/plugins/system-spec-harness"
ST=R+"/system-spec/spec-state.json"; FR=R+"/system-spec/fetched-references.json"
C12=P+"/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py"; C13=P+"/scripts/validate-source-citation.py"; HS=P+"/scripts/validate-hearing-sources.py"
h=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def run(c):
    r=subprocess.run(c,capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=R); return {"exit_code":r.returncode,"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr}
pre={p:h(p) for p in (ST,FR,C12,C13,HS)}
mv={"state_path":ST,"state_sha256":h(ST),"validator_path":C12,"validator_sha256":h(C12),
    "loop":run(["python3",C12,"--matrix",ST]),"require_complete":run(["python3",C12,"--matrix",ST,"--require-complete"])}
argv=["python3",C13,"--targets",ST,"--references",FR,"--state",ST,"--repo-root",R]
r=run(argv)
dv={"repo_root":R,"inputs":{"targets":{"path":ST,"sha256":h(ST)},"references":{"path":FR,"sha256":h(FR)},"state":{"path":ST,"sha256":h(ST)}},
    "validator_path":C13,"validator_sha256":h(C13),"argv":argv,**r}
hs=run(["python3",HS,"--matrix",ST,"--repo-root",R])
post={p:h(p) for p in (ST,FR,C12,C13,HS)}
print("STABLE",pre==post)
print("MV="+json.dumps(mv,ensure_ascii=False))
print("DV="+json.dumps(dv,ensure_ascii=False))
print("HS_exit",hs["exit_code"],"stderr",hs["stderr"]); print("HS="+hs["stdout"])
PY
